transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I guess what brings me here is... my talking gets all mixed up. I'll try to explain something to people, like about the keys, and then I'm talking about the jail, and then the prayer rug, and then chess pieces. It just comes out that way. People keep telling me they can't follow what I'm saying. So... that's why I came in.
Do you feel like your thoughts are disconnected from each other when this happens?

Yeah, that's exactly it. Like I was just saying... they just don't hook up right. I start out on one thing, like the keys, and then my brain just jumps over to the jail, and then the prayer rug, or the chess pieces. It just breaks apart. I can't keep it in a straight line, and that's why people keep telling me they can't follow a word I'm saying.
Do you ever hear voices or see things that aren't there?

Yeah, I do hear things sometimes. Like... I'll be at work, and I hear a man's voice coming from the air vents. Or sometimes it's coming from inside the mop closet. He says my name, or he just keeps telling me that I ruined everything. And it's not like a thought... it sounds just as real as if somebody was standing right beside me saying it.
Do you have difficulty doing everyday tasks or taking care of yourself?

Yeah, it's... it's gotten pretty bad. I've missed a lot of shifts at work, and I've actually lost some of my cleaning jobs because of it. People just say they can't rely on me anymore, or they can't understand what I'm doing. I even stopped going to the mosque and stopped showing up to family gatherings for the same reason. They just can't understand me. And... well, sometimes things get so out of hand that I'm not safe, and other people have had to call for emergency help. So, yeah, it's definitely making it hard to just live my life.
Do you have trouble behaving appropriately in social situations?

I don't think so... I mean, I don't really know what you mean by that. I just told you I stopped going to family things and the mosque because people don't understand me when my thoughts get all broken up. But I don't think I'm doing anything inappropriate, like acting out or anything. It's just... I just don't go out much anymore.
Do you ever find yourself doing things that don't make sense to you or other people?

No, I don't think so. I mean... I just try to go about my day. I don't really find myself doing things that don't make sense. If I'm cleaning, I'm just cleaning, you know? I haven't noticed myself doing anything strange, if that's what you're asking.
Have you ever found yourself dressing in an unusual way or having trouble taking care of your personal appearance?

No, I don't think so. I mean... I mostly just wear my work clothes. Jeans and a t-shirt, usually. I still shower and shave and keep myself clean. So, no, I haven't noticed any problems with how I dress or take care of myself.
Do you have any unusual physical movements or mannerisms that people have commented on?

No, nobody's ever said anything like that to me. I mean... my job is pretty physical, doing a lot of sweeping and mopping and stuff, so I'm moving around all day. But I just move normal. I haven't noticed any weird twitches or anything, and no one else has pointed anything out to me either.
Do these mixed-up thoughts and hearing voices happen all the time or do they come and go?

Well, they don't really come and go. It's more like... they're just there all the time. The voices, and those worries I have about being watched or marked... I've been dealing with that for about a year and a half now. It hasn't really stopped since it started.
Do you ever feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to do a lot of different things. I liked taking pictures, playing chess... I used to go to the mosque, and I'd even cook for my neighbors sometimes. But now... I don't know. The camera just stays in the drawer. And when people call me, I just don't answer the phone anymore. I just don't have the interest in it like I used to.
Do you feel like you've become withdrawn or isolated from others over time?

Yeah, I have. I mean... I stopped going to the mosque, and I don't really go to family gatherings anymore either. People tell me they can't rely on me, or that they just don't understand me. 

It's messed up my work, too. I've missed shifts and actually lost some of my cleaning jobs because of it. And... well, there have been a few times where I was unsafe enough that other people had to call for emergency help. So, yeah, I guess I have gotten pretty isolated.
Do you have periods where your thoughts are completely normal and you don't hear any voices?

Well, no, not completely normal. I mean, there have been calmer weeks... times when I wasn't feeling super sped up and high, and I wasn't feeling totally down in the dumps either. But even during those calmer times, for a couple of weeks or more, I still heard the man talking in the vents. And I still knew that the people in the building were signaling each other about me. So, the voices and the worries... they don't really go away, even when my mood is okay.
Have you ever done things that seemed strange or bizarre to others, even if they made sense to you at the time?

I don't really think so. I mean... I know I said earlier that people don't always understand me, but I don't think I do things that are strange or bizarre. I just do what I need to do. I haven't really noticed doing anything out of the ordinary, or at least, nobody has pointed out anything specific to me like that. I just try to keep to myself mostly.
Have you ever had difficulty performing tasks in a logical order or sequence?

No, I don't think so. I mean, my job is mostly cleaning, so it's pretty routine. You sweep, you mop, you take out the trash. I just do it step by step like I always have. I haven't really noticed getting mixed up or doing things out of order.
Have you ever done things that you knew were not normal behavior for you, but you did them anyway?

No, I don't think so. If I do something, it's because I feel like I need to do it at the time. I don't... I don't just go out and do things I know aren't right or aren't normal for me. I just stick to my routine, mostly. You know, go to work, clean up, go home. I haven't noticed doing anything like what you're asking about.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't hear any voices at all?
No, not really. Not for a long time. The voices... and this feeling that I'm being watched, or marked, or whatever it is... it's been going on for about a year and a half now. It just doesn't stop.
Do you feel like you've lost motivation to do things you normally would?

Yeah, I have. I used to enjoy doing a lot of things... taking pictures, playing chess, going to the mosque. I'd even cook for my neighbors sometimes. 

But now, I just... well, the camera just stays in the drawer. I don't even look at it. And when people call me, I just don't answer the phone. I just don't have it in me to do any of that stuff anymore.
Do you often find yourself engaging in behaviors that seem disorganized or lacking in purpose to others?

No, I don't think so. I mean, nobody has ever told me I'm doing things that don't make sense. Like I said, I just stick to my routine. I go to work, clean the building, come home. I don't wander around or do things for no reason. Everything I do has a purpose to me.
Do you feel like you've become emotionally flat or have a hard time expressing your emotions to others?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I still feel things just fine. I get angry, or sad... especially with everything going on with the voices and feeling watched. 

I just don't have a lot of people to show my emotions to right now, since, like I said, I keep to myself and don't answer the phone. But inside, I wouldn't say I'm flat or anything like that.
